lines.en: : Huh. It’s just a normal hotel room. There are no...ropes or shackles or anything.

: And I mean very open. Like, way too open.

: Yes. But still.

: It really is just Nodoka, Sensei. I...have no intention of telling Rin or anyone else.
: I...can’t really imagine it would go over well if anyone heard it and...
: Well, I can’t really imagine anyone believing it anyway if even Nodoka is thinking it’s not true.
: Futaba, I don’t think you’re lying because you aren’t “good enough” for Sensei or whatever it is your self-deprecating brain is making you think right now.
: I think you’re lying because just a year ago you had no idea what a handjob was.
: And if you managed to go from my innocent little girl to a full on nymphomaniac in less than one[school] year, I would be shocked.
: Proud as well, don’t get me wrong. But mostly shocked.
: Actually, can we just talk about something else? This is starting to make me feel a little uncomfortable.
: Because you’re pretending to be experienced in something you don’t know the first thing about?
: You say that like you do...
: I have plenty of experience. Just all of it is either in word form or a secret realm beyond that of earth inside of our[school]'s various custodial rooms.
: So, did you two really just come in here to banter about Futaba’s alleged sexual experience?
: Partially. Though I suppose it doesn’t do anyone good with all of us just standing around and making no progress.
: What...kind of progress do you want to make, exactly?
: Oh, I don’t know. A little of this. A little of that.
Nodoka slips a book out of her bag and places it on the ottoman next to the table in my room.
She also decides to help herself to a glass of champagne without asking so, assuming that it isn’t complimentary, I might owe Touka some money.
Futaba and I follow her lead (Not with the champagne, but with the sitting thing) and take our places several inches apart from one another on the bed opposite Nodoka.
: Do you mind if I read?
: I’m beginning to realize that I won’t be enjoying any live action taboo pornography tonight.
: Nodoka, would you mind explaining to me why we are friends again?
: Why would confiding in you about a personal detail of mine suddenly invite you into my more...personal life anyway?
: Obviously, so I could make sure that you’re performing adequately.
: I think I would be able to-
: Do you have any idea how many highly detailed blowjobs I have written? How many deflorations? How many dubiously consensual sex scenes in the backs of cars?
: Um...yes...I’ve read...quite a few of them.
: Then you should know that I could easily remain impartial in the face of something like that and wouldn’t mind even in the slightest.
: If you’re so confident, why not put your apparent skills to the test?
: Wonderful idea, Sensei.
: Futaba, remove your clothes and I will show you the proper way to please a woman.
: Oh my god...
: I mean...I wouldn’t mind watching if you two are going to-
: You’re not helping, Sensei...
: Nodoka has been saying things like this to me since before either of us started...growing.
: I’ve been a bit of a deviant forever, truth be told.
: I’m just...not really interested in girls like that...

: I mean-
: That wasn’t serious! I’m not going to invite Rin! She’d never look at me the same way again!
: But Nodoka would?
: Futaba could put a gun directly into your mouth and pull the trigger without affecting my outlook on the sweet, delicate girl she is on the inside.
: That is terrifying.
: What’s even more terrifying is the thought that she could be so easily corrupted.
: You see, my Futaba is my Futaba because she’s always been so oblivious to the more carnal desires of life-

: Subject to living a life of wondering what the strange feelings she’s going through are.
: Then, one night, when no one else is around...I would help her indulge in those feelings. Show her all of the wonderful things that she has been missing out on.
: Nodoka...I really-
: And to think that she’d start having experiences like that without me being in the room for them is just...not possible.

: You see, Futaba and I are a package deal. And despite my tendency to indulge in taboo fiction, I’d strongly resist the urge to give into such a huge character change without her being there to witness it.
: Oh my god, Nodoka! Shut up already!
: Granted, she has denied me the opportunity to...experiment on her on multiple occasions now. But I remain hopeful that one day, I may get to bury my face in her tender breasts.
: She’s still going, huh?
: Fucking...
: I’m sorry, Sensei. I can’t deal with this anymore.
: What? What are you-
: Oh.
: Uhh...
: I’m not sure why Futaba is suddenly so dead set on making me believe that she is growing up on her own, but I-
: Well, I’ll be damned.
: Futaba? This is...
: This is to show Nodoka that I’m not a liar. And that I don’t need her to be there for me to...start doing things like this.
: You are proving that...you don’t need me to be around...by giving our teacher a handjob while I am literally right behind you?
: What an incredibly convoluted and mysterious train of thought.
: It’s not! I’m just...exhausted always hearing about how delicate I am when...I’m really not anymore.
: So yeah...I used to be, but...Sensei has been helping me and...
: And I actually really like doing this stuff! It’s fun!
: O, carve not with thy hours my love's fair brow,\nNor draw no lines there with thine antique pen!
: Him in thy course untainted do allow\nFor beauty's pattern to succeeding men.
: What does Sonnet 19 have to do with this?
: It’s an age old poem marking the passage of time and the ferocity of its tiger-like claws.
: I feel like it was just the other day we were playing in the playground...enjoying our youth.
: That was just the other day. You were wearing the same exact outfit.
: Alas, my little girl is now a woman. And apparently has been for quite some time.
: And here I am, sitting on an ottoman, reaching out for a book instead of enjoying the wonders of life and love.
: C'est la vie...
Nodoka grabs her book and decides to leave the room so Futaba and I can-
Oh, wait. Nope.
Apparently she’s coming right over here.
: Wait, holy shit. I guess she wasn’t lying about the size either.
: Did you really have to bring the book?
: No, but I also didn’t expect you to be this...impressive.
: Do you believe me now, Nodoka?
: Uhh...yes. Why, yes I do.
: Though, your technique could use some improvement.
: May I?
: You may not.
: She may.
: Sensei says I may.
: You may not.
: Then I suppose I will just watch.
Damn it.
: Why not make this into a competition?
: You just want Nodoka to jerk you off.

: Jesus, it’s like the size of my forearm.
: Think about it, Futaba. You have experience doing this and she doesn’t. It could be an easy point for your team.
: This contest would absolutely not be approved.
: Doesn’t have to be. We could just tell them you two were in a secret...poetry contest or something. I don’t know.
: You just want Nodoka to jerk you off.
: It’s like half the size of the tiny, quiet girl in the back of the classroom.
: Nodoka, do you want to turn this into a competition?

: Sensei...
: Okay.
: Are you sure? You seem a little uncertain.
: I’m definitely certain. I was just thinking that “cumpetition” would be a better word to describe something like this.
: Do you really want a girl who says things like that touching you?
: Honestly...yeah.
: You two are...annoyingly similar.
: Then you have no excuse to not perform sex acts with and/or on me!
: I don’t need one. Just let me have some aspect of privacy in my life.

Nodoka moves closer to me and leans on one of my legs as Futaba begins to increase her speed, not showing any sign of giving up my penis.

: Do you remember that one story I wrote about the two sisters who would take turns pleasing each other while their mother secretly watched from the doorway?
: Unfortunately. But what does-

: Oh, you know what, yeah. I’m starting to feel it now.

: You joined in eventually. I just figured that based on everything I’ve heard tonight that you wouldn’t want to hear about that part.
: But my god, did Ms. Watabe teach me so many things in that dream.

: Hey, sorry to interrupt, but the “contest” is about to end.

And, just like the actual “contest,” the entire thing is extremely casual.
There are jokes to be made about Futaba’s sudden switch from innocent to not, but none of them are malicious and...well, she seems to handle it all surprisingly well.
It’s nothing like the Futaba I first ran into at the library, which seems so long ago now.
And I’m sure that some of it has to do with the fact that it was Nodoka beside her and not anyone else-
But I know that some of it is simply because she has grown.
And will continue to grow.
Just like a tree.
